# fill zeros lying strictly between any two 8s aligned
out=[r[:] for r in g]; R=len(g); C=len(g[0])
for i in range(R):
 for j in range(C):
  if g[i][j]!=0: continue
  if any(g[i][k]==8 for k in range(j)) and any(g[i][k]==8 for k in range(j+1,C)): out[i][j]=3
  if any(g[k][j]==8 for k in range(i)) and any(g[k][j]==8 for k in range(i+1,R)): out[i][j]=3
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,r)) for r in out))
